From: bram@example.com

Hi there,

I hope you're doing well. I'm writing about order A2288, the desk lamp, which arrived on the 17th. First off, my week has been chaotic. My sister is visiting with her two dogs, one of whom has decided my slippers are a snack, and I've been working late on a spreadsheet for my book club's budget (yes, we have one, don't ask). Anyway, I finally set the lamp up on my desk last night and it's lovely, really, but there's a small scratch on the base and the switch feels a little loose. Nothing dramatic, and I'd rather keep it than go through a return, since I've already found the perfect spot for it. Would it be possible to get a partial refund of $8.00 for the trouble? I'd really appreciate it. Thanks so much, and have a great day!

Bram

expected.note: because we don't do partial refunds.
